scope: Focused isolated recovery implementation evidence; not final canonical hosted/native qualification, deployment, harness qualification, or performance measurement.

environment.sandbox: existing bwrap canonical environment including private 1MiB /fault-fs
environment.dependencies: locked/offline, prepared static SQLite reused for focused Rust iterations
environment.preparation: actual pinned-tool preflight and actual static SQLite build passed in fresh initial disposable state; subsequent source snapshots reused only that private Cargo/SQLite build state

results.maintainability: 8 production and 7 test files; one 52-line cohesive function reviewed, no file >300 nonblank

behavioral_red_green.meaning: Before recovery implementation, actual wire-schema baseline accepts synthetic prompt content in a legal TurnId. This is schema insufficiency, not a claim of existing persistence regression.
Reviewer-found held-preview regular FDs retain deleted log bytes beyond four MiB.
behavioral_red_green.green: retained-bytes-green.json and public.json; corrected handles retain identity/lock, not regular FDs.

behavioral_red_green.meaning: Reviewer-found UUID ordering selected sequences64..33 before1..32 despite complete64-record backlog.
Only remove required turn-source gate before serialization; leave replay gate intact. Real staging leaves one forbidden artifact and test fails.

actual_faults: SIGKILL at created, file+directory-fsynced staging, and rename checkpoints in private unit-test children
Regular-file ENOSPC on fixed tmpfs after proving type and <=1MiB capacity; bounded fill; failed stage leaves accounted empty partial and no receipt; reopen cleanup and subsequent stage succeed
Public write-open attempt on verifier read-only /work fails
Symlink, hardlink, nonprivate modes, directory substitution, retained token/in-place replacement, stale/cross-store plans
Canary scans of all manager recovery artifacts and fixed logs across success, crash, full filesystem and cleanup; root owns combined DB/WAL/coordinator diagnostic scan
limitations: M1 production source-mapping registry is empty; private synthetic mappings qualify no live adapter.
Long-lived token ownership prevents a second store until release. Full stat identity detects ordinary replacement; same-UID malicious races are not isolated.
TTL limits replay eligibility; explicit caller maintenance applies cleanup. No automatic M1 scheduler.
rejected_attempts and discarded_artifacts are volatile attempt/artifact units, not unique lost events; unknown_gap remains explicit.
No physical block-device durability or callback-time performance claim.
